description: This Java interface defines an InboundExternalMessage, representing messages received by Ditto, including methods to access the source message, topic path, and mapped signal.

classes.name: InboundExternalMessage
classes.description: Interface representing an inbound message with accessors for source message, topic path, and signal.

methods.name: getTopicPath
methods.description: Returns the topic path of the mapped message.

methods.name: getSignal
methods.description: Returns the Signal mapped from the inbound ExternalMessage.
